title: LedgerCleaner repair depends on peer availability
severity_reason: Repair succeeds for every ledger a peer holds (3 of 4: one recovered from the peer, one with a re-saved SQL row), and fails for the one ledger no peer holds (1000), which is dropped from the complete set. A pruned ledger with no full peer cannot be repaired.
notes: The node holds 1-2000 in SQL but two ledgers lost their node-store objects (1000, 1500) and one has a corrupted SQL hash (1600). The only peer holds 1258-2500. The cleaner acquires the ledger first (which re-stores its nodes), then compares against the SQL row.
